Name: Fill the Town IDOLS
Author: gqhong
Description:
[b]NOTE : This is the first version and there is limited testing. Please let me know if you encounter any bugs. thanks :)[/b]

[b]Purpose : [/b]
With this mod the touring Girl Idol Group MRS will come to Ridgeside early Spring. ( 4 - 7 Spring )
They would do some promotions in Town before preforming on Friday and Saturday.

[b]WARNING[/b] : Due to the popularity of the idol group many of the villagers will be partying near the stage or spend their time queuing for an autograph when MRS does their promotions.... Some may abandon their store duties totally (damnit Clint...). You have been warned...

Bouncers will follow MRS members during their promotion tour in Town and During the stage performance.
Please keep away from the stage during that time.

[b]Bouncer NPCS[/b]
Bouncer Bob
Bouncer Bobby
Bouncer Blob
Bouncer Blobby

[b]MRS Members[/b]
Miso
Rami
Shui

Currently in testing is the integration with the Red School mod and "Fill the School" ( https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13683 )
If you these installed ( and unlocked the school ), Penny and Flor will bring the kids out for a school excursion to join the concert on Friday.

Planned Updates :
More events with the Idol Group Members
More people will attend the concert
MRS special edition items ( Pierre wants to make more profits )
MRS special food at Pika during concert time
